final_text:
Result: the task-rewriting trick didn't help, and I recommend we drop it.

We ran 48 tests. The share of answers that got accepted did not go up. Paid token use more than doubled, so costs would rise with no benefit.

Caveat: this doesn't prove the trick is useless. Our test tasks were too easy. The agent already did well without it, so there was almost no room to show an improvement. The test couldn't have shown a gain even if one exists.

Options:
1. Stop here and save the cost. This is my recommendation.
2. Rerun on harder tasks. That costs more time and tokens, and it's the only way to learn whether the trick really works.

Which do you prefer?
